standard.summary: 使用多分辨率噪声替代标准高斯噪声：生成多个不同分辨率的噪声图并加权叠加，有助于学习多尺度特征。
standard.effect: iterations=6 = 生成 6 个不同分辨率的噪声层叠加。使模型同时学习全局结构和局部细节的噪声去除。
standard.whenToUse: 希望 LoRA 同时改善全局构图和局部细节时可以尝试。对风格类 LoRA 可能有益。
standard.avoidWhen: 不确定效果时不建议使用，多分辨率噪声改变了训练分布，可能需要更多步数才能收敛。

standard_en.summary: Replaces standard Gaussian noise with multi-resolution noise: several noise maps at different resolutions are generated and summed with weights, which helps the model learn multi-scale features.
standard_en.effect: iterations=6 means six noise layers at different resolutions are generated and stacked. The model then learns to remove noise from the global structure and the local detail at the same time.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth trying when you want a LoRA to improve global composition and local detail together. It may benefit style LoRAs.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not recommended while you are unsure of the effect: multi-resolution noise changes the training distribution and may need more steps to converge.

advanced.principle: 生成 N 个不同下采样分辨率的高斯噪声，上采样回原始分辨率后加权叠加（discount 控制每层权重的衰减）。多分辨率噪声包含更多低频成分，引导模型学习全局特征。
advanced.tradeoffs: multires_noise 显著改变噪声分布，与标准 noise schedule 不完全兼容，可能影响推理时使用标准采样器的效果。

advanced_en.principle: Generates N Gaussian noises at different downsampled resolutions, upsamples each back to original resolution, and sums with weights (discount controls per-level weight decay). Multi-resolution noise contains more low-frequency components, guiding the model toward global features.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: multires_noise substantially changes the noise distribution and is not fully compatible with the standard noise schedule — it may affect results when standard samplers are used at inference.
